programs.title: King Solomon's Mines 1
programs.desc: The first in a Double Bill:  Safari hunter, Allan Quartermain, heads into Africa in order to rescue a man, who had disappeared while searching for the fabled lost gold mines of King Solomon.

programs.title: King Solomon's Mines 2
programs.desc: Part 2 of a Double Bill:  Legends of countless riches lie ahead as Quartermain and his crew of explorers encounter thrilling twists and turns deep down in King Solomon's mines.

programs.title: Ex Next Door
programs.desc: Katie Gatewood's love for her husband Dan is put to the test when Dan's obsessed ex-girlfriend Louisa moves into the house next door, intending to drive the happy couple apart by any means necessary.

programs.title: Kill Thy Neighbour
programs.desc: When Julie’s husband dies, she moves cross-country to rebuild her life with son Matty and build a closer relationship with her late husband’s sister, Alison. Yet Alison blames Julie for her brother’s death and has a plan to become Matty’s mother...no matter who gets hurt in the process.

programs.title: McLintock!
programs.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programs.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programs.desc: When terrorists are about to cause a nuclear disaster at Chernobyl, the only one who can stop them is Luc Deveraux, a retired Universal Soldier.
